skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts and principles of microeconomics, analyze simple economic models, and apply theories to practical problems.
Analyze consumer and business behavior, understand market structures, and evaluate economic policies.
Develop independent thinking and critical analysis skills to solve economic problems.
Apply economic theories to solve practical economic problems.
Conduct research, analyze, synthesize, and generalize economic issues.
Work independently and in groups to solve economic problems.
Develop self-learning and research skills to enhance professional knowledge.
Maintain discipline, be proactive, and take responsibility for assigned tasks.
Communicate effectively in class discussions and group activities.
Manage time effectively to complete assignments and prepare for exams.
Understand different market structures and their impact on business behavior.
Analyze international trade and government policies affecting trade.
Understand the role of government in addressing market failures and economic policies.
